name: Codestral 25.08
short: Mistral's refreshed 22B single-purpose code model (`codestral-2508`, 2025) behind the `codestral-latest` alias — fill-in-the-middle autocomplete, code correction and test generation across 80+ languages at 256K context.
modalities: Text, code in; text, code out
pricingNote: Hosted ~$0.30/$0.90 per 1M in/out (La Plateforme); source-available weights for free self-host.
pricingTiers: La Plateforme / cloud marketplaces ~$0.30/$0.90 per 1M in/out
standout: Best-in-class cheap FIM autocomplete: ~95% HumanEval-FIM pass@1 at 256K context for $0.30/$0.90.
tradeoff: A single-shot 22B completion engine — no reasoning/agentic modes, no independent AA row (all capability numbers are vendor-run), and LiveCodeBench 31.5 sits far below 2026 agentic coders.
